trace.title: Protocol Trace
trace.description: Log the traffic between the editor and language servers to the per-server log buffer.

restartLimit.title: Maximum Automatic Restarts
restartLimit.description: How many times a crashed language server is restarted automatically before giving up.

codeLens.title: Code Lens
codeLens.description: Actionable command links rendered above the symbols they describe.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show code lens links above symbols. Also settable per language in scoped settings.

semanticTokens.title: Semantic Tokens
semanticTokens.description: Server-computed highlighting layered over the grammar's own.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Color identifiers with the language server's semantic classification. Also settable per language in scoped settings.

inlayHints.title: Inlay Hints
inlayHints.description: Inline type and parameter-name labels rendered between characters.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show inlay hints in the visible part of the editor. Also settable per language in scoped settings.

maxLabelLength.title: Maximum Label Length
maxLabelLength.description: Longer hint labels are truncated with an ellipsis.

statusBar.title: Status Bar
statusBar.description: Indicator for the language servers this window is running.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Show the running language servers in the status bar. The item stays in place while none is running, reporting zero.
